literal: Blazing bright, Loyal Valor — heroic talent crowned the age.
idiomatic: Blazing with loyal might — a hero whose gifts outshone every man of his day.

literal: Cruelty at the Under-the-Gate office; in advance and retreat, only the ravine.
idiomatic: Cruel was the Gate that held him — advance or retreat, only a gorge on every side.

literal: On the banks of the Yellow River, he followed righteousness and lost his life.
idiomatic: Where the Yellow River runs, he met righteousness with his body — and died.

literal: Master Feng stood lofty and bold; together they crossed the age's distress.
idiomatic: Master Feng rose splendid — together they forded the age's bitter straits.

literal: Following bright virtue, radiance and glory renewed day by day.
idiomatic: Their line took up bright virtue — its radiance renewed with each passing day.

literal: The entire text has been collated against the November 1972 first edition of the Book of Northern Qi published by Zhonghua Shuju.
idiomatic: The entire text has been collated against the November 1972 first edition of the Book of Northern Qi published by Zhonghua Shuju.
